title: The canal running beside the road
text: The big concrete canal running beside Interstate 5 through this part of the valley is the California Aqueduct, and the town of Lost Hills stands on its east bank. It is the main work of the California State Water Project, and it serves about 35 million people and 5.7 million acres of farmland. A typical stretch is 40 feet across at the bottom, with the water about 30 feet deep. Altogether it runs 444 miles.
